what_to_detect: A static conditioned on the city's blessing (Condition$ Blessing) contributes to the board because its controller, controlling ten or more permanents with an ascend permanent, got the blessing.
near_miss: The same blessing-conditioned static applies to the board and contributes nothing: its controller lacks the blessing.
record_fields: acting static line's Condition$ (Blessing), read through the sidecar
field pt alone matches every P/T static in the corpus

what_to_detect: A static conditioned on the city's blessing keeps contributing after its controller drops below ten permanents: the blessing lasts the rest of the game.
near_miss: The same blessing-conditioned static contributes nothing for a player who never had the blessing.
record_fields: acting static line's Condition$ (Blessing), read through the sidecar
entity count of the controller's permanents

what_to_detect: A trigger evaluated against an event that gave a player the city's blessing sees the board with the blessing-conditioned continuous effects already applied, and fires on that board.
near_miss: The same trigger evaluated against an event that left the player without the blessing, on a board without those effects, and not fired.
record_fields: gen-3 player snapshot city_blessing in the trigger record's snapshot
entity power/toughness in the snapshot; mode and destination alone match every enters-the-battlefield trigger
